errors.invalidToken: Your session has expired or is no longer valid: sign in again
errors.cannotDelete: Cannot delete: resource is in use
errors.inUseByCocktails: Cannot delete: this item is used by cocktail recipes
errors.categoryNotEmpty: Cannot delete: this category still contains bottles
errors.typeInUse: Cannot delete: categories still use this type
errors.cannotModifySystemMenu: System menus cannot have their slug or type changed
errors.fileTooLarge: The file or request is too large
errors.invalidImage: The photo cannot be read: send a JPEG, PNG or WebP image
errors.invalidJson: The request body is not valid JSON
errors.backupSchemaTooNew: This backup comes from a newer version of Carta Cocktail: update the application before restoring it
errors.restoreInProgress: A backup restore is already in progress: wait for it to finish, then reload the page and sign in again (the restore ends every session)
errors.exportInProgress: A backup is being exported: wait for its download to finish, then start the restore again
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed login attempts: try again in a few minutes
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many requests: try again in a few minutes
errors.passwordTooShort: The new password must be at least 12 characters long
errors.invalidEmail: The email address is not valid
errors.bottleNotAllowedInMenu: This bottle cannot go in this menu: only bottles checked for the menu's type (aperitif or digestif) can
errors.cocktailNotAllowedInMenu: This cocktail cannot go in this menu: only a cocktail menu can hold cocktails
errors.cannotSyncCocktailMenu: A cocktail menu has no bottles to synchronize
errors.cannotSyncPersonalMenu: Only the Aperitifs and Digestifs menus follow the bottles: add the bottles of this menu by hand
errors.systemMenuBottlesManaged: The bottles of this menu follow their aperitif / digestif box: remove a bottle or put a removed one back instead
errors.exclusionsSystemMenuOnly: Only the Aperitifs and Digestifs menus keep a list of removed bottles
errors.menuTypeImmutable: The type of a menu cannot be changed after its creation
errors.reorderDuplicateIds: The new order lists the same item twice
errors.reorderIncomplete: The new order must list every item of the menu
errors.reorderForeignIds: The new order lists an item that is not in this menu
errors.sectionNotInMenu: This section is not one of this menu's sections
errors.unknownReference: A recipe line names a unit, bottle, category or ingredient that does not exist (it may have just been deleted): reload the page and check the recipe
errors.importUnresolved: The recipe cannot be imported: some of its units, bottles, categories or ingredients are neither matched with an existing one nor created (a new bottle also needs its category)
errors.ambiguousCategoryName: Several categories match "{{name}}" when case is ignored, and none exactly: {{matches}}. Use one of them, or rename them so that their names differ by more than case
errors.ambiguousUnitAbbreviation: Several units match the abbreviation "{{name}}" when case is ignored, and none exactly: {{matches}}. Use one of them, or change their abbreviations so that they differ by more than case

embedOrigin.notAnOrigin: "{{origin}}" is not a site address: write it as https://www.example.com, without a path
embedOrigin.wildcard: "{{origin}}": the * wildcard is not accepted, list each site in full
embedOrigin.insecure: "{{origin}}" uses http://: only https:// sites can embed the menu (http:// is accepted for localhost and 127.0.0.1 only)
embedOrigin.tooMany: At most {{max, number}} sites can embed the menu

import.missingColumn: The CSV file must have a name column and a capacityMl column
import.malformedHeader: The column names of {{file}} (its first line) have a misplaced quotation mark
import.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON
import.unsupportedVersion: This file is not a bottle export of Carta Cocktail, or its version is not supported
import.bottlesRequired: The JSON file has no list of bottles
import.invalidZip: The ZIP archive could not be read
import.zipMissingBottles: The ZIP archive must contain bottles.csv or bottles.json
import.zipEntryTooLarge: A file of the ZIP archive is over {{maxMb, number}} MB once uncompressed
import.unsupportedFormat: Unsupported file format: use a .csv, .json or .zip file
import.tooManyRows: The file has more than {{max, number}} rows: split it into several imports
import.tooManyBottles: The import would create more than {{max, number}} bottles: split it into several imports

errors.apiTokenReadOnly: This API token is read-only: create a read and write token to change data
errors.mcpToolTimeout: The API took too long to answer the tool: try again
errors.apiTokenSessionOnly: API tokens cannot use this route: sign in to the admin panel instead
errors.apiTokenLimit: You already have {{max, number}} active API tokens: revoke one before creating another
errors.codeModeDeletion: Code Mode cannot delete anything: the admin deletes in the app
errors.codeModeSessionOnly: Code Mode cannot use this route: the admin uses it in the app
errors.codeModeUnknownOperation: No admin operation of the API has this method and path: find one with the search tool
errors.codeModeFileUpload: This operation takes a file, which Code Mode cannot send
errors.codeModeInvalidPath: The path must start with / and hold no ?, # or \: put the query in `query`
errors.codeModeTooManyRequests: This run made as many calls to the server as it may: see the limits in the description of the tool
errors.codeModeCodeTooLong: The code is too long: see the limits in the description of the tool
errors.codeModeNotAFunction: The code must be an async arrow function, such as: async () => { … }
errors.codeModeCpuTime: The code computed for too long: it was stopped
errors.codeModeWallTime: The code did not finish in time: it was stopped
errors.codeModeCrashed: The code exhausted the resources of the sandbox (stack or memory): it was stopped
errors.codeModeBusy: The server is already running as much code as it may: try again in a moment
errors.codeModeCancelled: The call was cancelled before its code ran

menuBottles.restored: Bottle put back in the menu
menuBottles.restoredMany: Bottles put back in the menu
